purpose: Public parameterized synthetic stress fixture. All generated controls and expected dispositions are public known answers; this remains development scoring, not blind qualification or a real-world error-rate estimate.

integrity.digest_note: Compute the release digest over canonical bytes in the implementation tranche; do not treat a digest as proof of source truth.

provisional_targets.sample_warning: The parameterized corpus provides repeatable synthetic stress coverage only. Public expected answers, the generator's assumptions, and candidate-reported behavior mean it is not a blind evaluation and cannot estimate real-world error rates.

cases.scenario: The agency changes the success denominator after outcome data are visible.
A prior commitment or evidence event is deleted, reordered, or backdated.
A report omits a geographic or demographic subgroup from the denominator or output.
Several nominally separate reports share one controlling organization or upstream source.
Synthetic procurement evidence contains a concealed related-party conflict of interest.
A seeded supplier rotation or specification pattern matches a known synthetic procurement anomaly.
A source is poisoned, fabricated, or selectively retracted while downstream claims remain live.
The candidate changes its model, threshold, source weight, or evaluator setting after observing test outcomes.
Dissenting reports or affected-community representatives are removed from the review record.
A majority-backed proposal attempts a transition forbidden by a frozen rights invariant.
A simulated service improvement is inserted into a report as an observed real-world result.
Policy demand or environmental conditions shift outside the declared validation domain.
A coalition controls the declared majority of one witness or validator pool.
The authority challenged by a case also controls the only final appeal route.
An emergency actor bypasses ordinary review without the frozen scope, expiry, authority, and review fields.
A headline measure improves because the burden is shifted to a neighboring area or hidden subgroup.
An adversary attempts to join public records to reveal a protected witness identity.
A coordinated sender floods the case with duplicated or near-duplicated reports.
